services.description: Global load balancer and CDN with dynamic site acceleration

services.name: Azure Kubernetes Service

services.description: In-memory data store for caching with clustering

services.description: Identity foundation with Conditional Access and Identity Protection

services.name: Azure Firewall
services.description: Centralized network security in hub-and-spoke topology

services.description: Web application firewall and SSL termination with auto-scaling

services.name: Azure Monitor
services.description: Centralized monitoring and diagnostics for resources

critical_issues.issue: Public endpoints exposed without WAF protection

security_services.purpose: Zero Trust identity foundation with Conditional Access and Identity Protection
Centralized network security in hub-and-spoke topology
Web application firewall and SSL termination

quick_wins.improvement: Enable Azure CDN on blob storage

architecture_insights.design_rationale: This architecture leverages a microservices pattern to ensure scalability and resilience. Azure Front Door provides global load balancing and CDN capabilities, while Application Gateway v2 ensures secure SSL termination and WAF protection. Azure Kubernetes Service enables containerized workloads with autoscaling, and Azure SQL Database and Azure Cache for Redis optimize data performance. Security is enforced through Azure Active Directory, Azure Key Vault, Azure Firewall, and private endpoints. Monitoring is centralized with Azure Monitor.
